qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Europe's #1 insurer generates unassailable scale economies in P&C underwriting and distribution, complemented by PIMCO's fixed-income asset management scale. Proven pricing power demonstrated by multi-year rate hikes outpacing European claims inflation, with 5Y median GAAP ROIC of 17.2% and combined ratio <94%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Peace-of-Mind Balance Sheet, REJECT). Europe's premier insurer boasts undisputed scale and underwriting discipline, but carries over €900B in total liabilities including complex life insurance guarantees and systemic European sovereign credit exposures. Under Munger's strict solvency standard, multi-line life liabilities fail the peace-of-mind test in a severe systemic crisis.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 EBIT of €16.2B, GAAP ROIC of 18.9% (5Y median 17.2%), and Solvency II ratio of 218%. While P&C underwriting is disciplined (combined ratio ~93%), total balance sheet liabilities exceed €900B with significant legacy life guarantees and European sovereign bond holdings. Common equity remains vulnerable to systemic credit freezes, violating the peace-of-mind balance sheet standard.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
